description: This file defines the main class DataFile which handles parsing, manipulation, and writing of data files according to a specified model and definition XML. It provides methods for reading data from URLs, streams, or strings, managing records, and outputting data back to files or strings.

classes.name: DataFile
classes.description: Main class for handling data file operations including reading, parsing, and writing data files based on model definitions.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Static method to create and load a DataFile from specified URLs for the data file and its definition.

methods.name: makeDataFile
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a DataFile object based on a definition URL and data file name.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Returns the list of Record objects contained in this DataFile.

methods.name: addRecord
methods.description: Adds a Record to the DataFile's list of records.

methods.name: makeRecord
methods.description: Creates a new Record object based on a model record name.

methods.name: readDataFile
methods.description: Loads and parses data from a URL, stream, or string into records.

methods.name: writeDataFile
methods.description: Outputs the data file content either as a string or to a file.
